signals.title: Savor of the Month (23)
signals.description: It’s November! So once again, it’s time for Savor of the Month ! For newcomers: At the start of every month I announce one specific thing or theme to look out for, pay attention to, interrogate, appreciate . The idea is to convert something everyday and taken for granted into something we might, yes, savor. And every month I create a chat thread where TAoN Supporters can share what you are noticing, or enjoy what others have noticed, in connection with the current theme. Supporters can post pictures, drawings, written observations , whatever works for you. Or just browse! Themes so far: Water (results here ) * Stripes (results here ) * Numbers (results here ) * Doors (results here ) * Pink (results here ) * Flaws (results here ) * Rust (results here ) * Public Text (results here ) * Calm (results here ) * Treasure (results here ) * Winter (results here ) * Mysteries (results here ) * Outliers (results here ) * Ornamentation (results here ) * Everyday Artists (results here ) * Reflections (results here ) * Contrast (results here ) * The Temporary (results here ; related audio essay here ) * Wind (results here ) * Circles (results here ) * Small Flowers (results here ) * Shadows (results here ) For November, the theme is BROKEN. Below, I’ll say a little more about this. But in short, whether you take pictures or write poems, or just notice your world: Be attentive to what’s BROKEN as you go about your days in the month ahead. The thread is open .
